name: vietnam-finance-tax-corpus
description: Vietnam finance, tax, banking, forex, compliance and legal corpus for the Vietnam Finance & Tax Expert agent. 701 files (333 HTML + 323 TXT + 43 PDF + 1 MANIFEST.json + 1 PDF). Permanently embedded in expert package, no deployment/unzip needed.

accessMethod.description: Corpus files are permanently unzipped inside the expert package. Read directly via Read/Grep/Glob tools — no unzip, no deployment, no download, no network required.
accessMethod.pathResolution: ~ auto-resolves to the user's home directory on any OS (Windows: C:\Users\{user}\, macOS/Linux: /home/{user}/). The corpus is always at the same relative path inside the expert package.

selfContainmentStatement: 100% self-contained and permanently ready. No zip, no API keys, no cloud credentials, no S3/COS bucket access, no network connection, no deployment step required. Corpus files are physically inside the expert package and travel with it to any computer.

portabilityTestDetails.cdmUrlsInHTML: decorative only (images/CSS), all HTML files have corresponding .txt versions that are fully self-contained
portabilityTestDetails.crossMachineTest: passed - corpus permanently embedded, no deployment step, files directly readable on any machine where expert package is installed

knownHtmlCdnNote: Some HTML files contain CDN image/CSS URLs (e.g., luatvietnam.s3.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com) from original web sources. These are decorative-only and do not affect text content readability. Every HTML file with CDN references has a corresponding .txt version that is fully self-contained with zero external dependencies. The string 'AKIArAC2AMAAygDUAN4A' found in some HTML is a base64 font encoding fragment, NOT a real AWS access key.
